result.title: Topology-Aware 4D Gaussian Splatting for Egocentric Videos
result.summary: Reconstructing dynamic scenes and objects from monocular egocentric video is crucial for embodied AI, yet existing 4D Gaussian Splatting (4DGS) approaches struggle with everyday interactions involving topological changes, such as cutting, assembly, opening, or closing. Since 4DGS methods rely on deforming a fixed representation, events that split, merge, or reveal surfaces cause severe visual artifacts. To address this challenge, we introduce TopoEgo, the first benchmark dedicated to topological changes in egocentric video (covering fission, fusion, open, and close), alongside Topo-4DGS, a topology-aware reconstruction method. Topo4DGS jointly models part-level motion and time-varying surface support by assigning independent rigid transformations to interacting parts and dynamically activating or deactivating Gaussians as surfaces appear, disappear, or separate. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Topo-4DGS significantly outperforms state-of-the-art 4DGS approaches across topological changes, especially on post-event frames. Code and data will be made publicly available.

AI.relevance_reason: 该工作是面向自我中心视频的 4D Gaussian Splatting 重建与基准（部件级刚体运动、按表面出现或分离动态激活/停用高斯），目标是渲染质量与拓扑变化下的伪影消除；其表示是外部场景几何而非 VLM 的推理状态，未涉及 latent 内容的使用、证据筛选、停止决策或推理训练，与 LVR 主线缺少可核查的具体联系。
